summary: Rocket Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on April 26, 2026, disclosing a definitive asset purchase agreement to sell its Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher (PRV) for $180 million in cash. The PRV was received from the FDA approval of KRESLADI for LAD-I. The buyer will pay upon closing, subject to customary conditions including HSR waiting period expiration. The agreement contains representations, warranties, and indemnification. The sale is non-core asset monetization. Watch for HSR clearance timing; risk-arb spreads minimal as cash deal.
